name: jest
description: A delightful JavaScript Testing Framework with a focus on simplicity

options.name: --bail
options.description: Exit the test suite immediately upon n number of failing test suite. Defaults to 1

options.name: -b
options.description: Exit the test suite immediately upon n number of failing test suite. Defaults to 1

options.name: --cache
options.description: Whether to use the cache

options.name: --no-cache
options.description: Whether to use the cache

options.name: --changedFilesWithAncestor
options.description: Runs tests related to the current changes and the changes made in the last commit

options.name: --changedSince
options.description: Runs tests related to the changes since the provided branch or commit hash

options.name: --ci
options.description: Instead of the regular behavior of storing a new snapshot automatically, will fail the test and require Jest to be run with --updateSnapshot

options.name: --clearCache
options.description: Deletes the Jest cache directory and then exits without running tests

options.name: --collectCoverageFrom
options.description: A glob pattern relative to rootDir matching the files that coverage info needs to be collected from

options.name: --colors
options.description: Forces test results output highlighting even if stdout is not a TTY

options.name: --config
options.description: The path to a Jest config file specifying how to find and execute tests

options.name: -c
options.description: The path to a Jest config file specifying how to find and execute tests

options.name: --coverage
options.description: Enable or disable coverage, disabled by default

options.name: --coverageProvider
options.description: Indicates which provider should be used to instrument code for coverage

options.name: --debug
options.description: Print debugging info about your Jest config

options.name: --detectOpenHandles
options.description: Attempt to collect and print open handles preventing Jest from exiting cleanly

options.name: --env
options.description: The test environment used for all tests

options.name: --errorOnDeprecated
options.description: Make calling deprecated APIs throw helpful error messages

options.name: --expand
options.description: Use this flag to show full diffs and errors instead of a patch

options.name: -e
options.description: Use this flag to show full diffs and errors instead of a patch

options.name: --findRelatedTests
options.description: Find and run the tests that cover a space separated list of source files that were passed in as arguments

options.name: --forceExit
options.description: Force Jest to exit after all tests have completed running

options.name: --help
options.description: Show the help information

options.name: --init
options.description: Generate a basic configuration file

options.name: --injectGlobals
options.description: Insert Jest's globals (expect, test, describe, beforeEach etc.) into the global environment

options.name: --json
options.description: Prints the test results in JSON

options.name: --outputFile
options.description: Write test results to a file when the --json option is also specified

options.name: --lastCommit
options.description: Run all tests affected by file changes in the last commit made

options.name: --listTests
options.description: Lists all tests as JSON that Jest will run given the arguments, and exits

options.name: --logHeapUsage
options.description: Logs the heap usage after every test

options.name: --maxConcurrency
options.description: Prevents Jest from executing more than the specified amount of tests at the same time

options.name: --maxWorkers
options.description: Specifies the maximum number of workers the worker-pool will spawn for running tests

options.name: -w
options.description: Specifies the maximum number of workers the worker-pool will spawn for running tests

options.name: --noStackTrace
options.description: Disables stack trace in test results output

options.name: --notify
options.description: Activates notifications for test results

options.name: --onlyChanged
options.description: Attempts to identify which tests to run based on which files have changed in the current repository

options.name: -o
options.description: Attempts to identify which tests to run based on which files have changed in the current repository

options.name: --passWithNoTests
options.description: Allows the test suite to pass when no files are found

options.name: --projects
options.description: Run tests from one or more projects, found in the specified paths; also takes path globs

options.name: --reporters
options.description: Run tests with specified reporters

options.name: --roots
options.description: A list of paths to directories that Jest should use to search for files in

options.name: --runInBand
options.description: Run all tests serially in the current process, rather than creating a worker pool of child processes that run tests

options.name: -i
options.description: Run all tests serially in the current process, rather than creating a worker pool of child processes that run tests

options.name: --selectProjects
options.description: Run only the tests of the specified projects

options.name: --runTestsByPath
options.description: Run only the tests that were specified with their exact paths

options.name: --setupTestFrameworkScriptFile
options.description: The path to a module that runs some code to configure or set up the testing framework before each test

options.name: --showConfig
options.description: Print your Jest config and then exits

options.name: --silent
options.description: Prevent tests from printing messages through the console

options.name: --testNamePattern
options.description: Run only tests with a name that matches the regex

options.name: -t
options.description: Run only tests with a name that matches the regex

options.name: --testLocationInResults
options.description: Adds a location field to test results

options.name: --testPathPattern
options.description: A regexp pattern string that is matched against all tests paths before executing the test

options.name: --testPathIgnorePatterns
options.description: An array of regexp pattern strings that are tested against all tests paths before executing the test

options.name: --testRunner
options.description: Lets you specify a custom test runner

options.name: --testSequencer
options.description: Lets you specify a custom test sequencer

options.name: --testTimeout
options.description: Default timeout of a test in milliseconds

options.name: --updateSnapshot
options.description: Use this flag to re-record every snapshot that fails during this test run

options.name: -u
options.description: Use this flag to re-record every snapshot that fails during this test run

options.name: --useStderr
options.description: Divert all output to stderr

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Display individual test results with the test suite hierarchy

options.name: --version
options.description: Print the version and exit

options.name: -v
options.description: Print the version and exit

options.name: --watch
options.description: Watch files for changes and rerun tests related to changed files

options.name: --watchAll
options.description: Watch files for changes and rerun all tests when something changes

options.name: --watchman
options.description: Whether to use watchman for file crawling

options.name: --no-watchman
options.description: Whether to use watchman for file crawling
